title: Marginal cost of continuing versus moving
summary: Dev5 computes only remaining future economics: stay cost versus move cost, checkpoint/restart, transfer, stop fees, billing floors, prepaid intervals and downtime. Sunk spend is not a savings lever. No real migration is triggered.
invariants: A lower hourly rate does not imply moving is cheaper.
Account for stranded prepaid compute, transfer fees, checkpoint I/O and restart time.
Apply minimum residence, absolute/percentage savings and deadline gates against migration churn.
The existing Migratable Job state machine remains the only owner of continuation operations.

provenance.claim: Cloud Economics v0.1-dev8 source evidence; status=IMPLEMENTED.

procedure: Establish remaining work and active source lease.
Check current native migration/continuation eligibility and route.
Evaluate marginal future stay and move cost across billing boundaries.
Classify recommendation only as OBSERVE, STAY or MOVE_ADVISORY; never dispatch.
